tools.name: ollanet_scan
tools.description: Discover reachable Ollama hosts and list their models. Use this before routing work to pick a host/model. Optional LAN TCP scan (off unless lan=true; equivalent to CLI --lan) and include offline Tailscale peers.

lan.description: TCP-scan local LAN CIDRs for open Ollama ports (default false)

all.description: Also probe offline Tailscale peers (default false)

last.description: Return the last saved scan without probing the network (default false)

tools.name: ollanet_prompt
tools.description: Send a prompt to an Ollama host on the network (or continue a saved chat by id). Returns the assistant reply and chat_id for follow-ups. Machine can be a discovered name, MagicDNS name, hostname, or IP[:port].

machine.description: Host name/IP (required for new chats; optional override when continuing)

model.description: Model name (optional; uses config default or chat model)

chat_id.description: Continue a saved chat by its hex hash id

system.description: System prompt (new chats, or if the chat has none yet)

file.description: Read prompt body from a local .txt or .md file (joined with prompt if both set)

tools.name: ollanet_compare
tools.description: Head-to-head: run the same prompt on 2–5 models on one Ollama host. Returns a summary plus saved markdown/JSON paths. Omit prompt/file to use the built-in mesh-host tasting prompt. Machine is a discovered name, MagicDNS name, hostname, or IP[:port].

prompt.description: Prompt text (optional; default is the built-in mesh-host prompt)

file.description: Read prompt from a local .txt or .md file

unload.description: Unload each model before the next (fairer tok/s)

tools.name: ollanet_pull
tools.description: Pull (or update) a model onto a reachable Ollama host. The named machine downloads from the registry onto its own disk — ollanet does not upload weights. Machine is a discovered name, MagicDNS name, hostname, or IP[:port].

machine.description: Host name/IP that should download the model

insecure.description: Allow HTTP / self-signed model registries (default false)

tools.name: ollanet_show
tools.description: Inspect a model on a reachable Ollama host (Modelfile, parameters, capabilities). Marks Finetuna-style tuned names. Machine is a discovered name, MagicDNS name, hostname, or IP[:port].

tools.name: ollanet_rm
tools.description: Delete a model from a reachable Ollama host's disk. Destructive. Requires confirm=true. Machine is a discovered name, MagicDNS name, hostname, or IP[:port].

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete (default false)

tools.name: ollanet_ps
tools.description: List models currently loaded in VRAM. Optional machine; omit to probe every discovered host. scan is on-disk inventory; ps is what is resident right now, with CPU/GPU %.

machine.description: Host name/IP (optional; omit for all discovered hosts)

tools.name: ollanet_list_chats
tools.description: List saved ollanet chat transcripts (id, topic, machine, model, message count).

tools.name: ollanet_get_chat
tools.description: Load one saved chat by id, including full message history.

chat_id.description: Hex chat hash from a prior prompt
